metadata.question: Does the Antarctic ozone hole size increase in September 2003 compared to September 2002?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use ECMWF ERA5 Monthly data (ECMWF/ERA5/MONTHLY), which includes total column ozone globally since 1979. Filter to September 2002 and September 2003 over Antarctica (south of 60°S).
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed (reanalysis). Validate ozone values by masking out invalid (<0 or >1000 DU after conversion).
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error: If collections for either month are empty -> C1. If valid pixel count after masking is 0 -> C2. If computed area is null/NaN or out of plausible range -> C3. Catch any dataset/band errors -> D.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const antGeom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle({coords: [-180, -90, 180, -60], geodesic: false});
    const months = [
      {year: 2002, start: '2002-09-01', end: '2002-10-01'},
      {year: 2003, start: '2003-09-01', end: '2003-10-01'}
    ];
    const DU_PER_KG_M2 = 2.1415e-5; // 1 DU = 2.1415e-5 kg/m^2
    const scale = 30000; // 30 km for speed/stability

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Band detection
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5/MONTHLY');
    const colSize = await col.size().getInfo();
    if (!colSize || colSize === 0) {
      console.log('Collection empty: ECMWF/ERA5/MONTHLY');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    const bandNames = await ee.Image(col.first()).bandNames().getInfo();
    if (!bandNames || bandNames.length === 0) {
      console.log('No bands available in ERA5 monthly.');
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }
    // Find an ozone band
    let ozoneBand = null;
    for (const b of bandNames) {
      if (/ozone/i.test(b) || /tco3/i.test(b)) { ozoneBand = b; break; }
    }
    // Common expected name
    if (!ozoneBand) {
      if (bandNames.includes('total_column_ozone')) ozoneBand = 'total_column_ozone';
      else if (bandNames.includes('total_ozone_column')) ozoneBand = 'total_ozone_column';
    }
    if (!ozoneBand) {
      console.log('No ozone band found in ERA5 monthly.');
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }
    console.log(`Dataset: ECMWF/ERA5/MONTHLY; Ozone band: ${ozoneBand}`);

    // Helper to compute ozone hole stats for a month
    async function monthStats(start, end, yearLabel) {
      const mcol = col.filterDate(start, end).select([ozoneBand]);
      const msize = await mcol.size().getInfo();
      console.log(`${yearLabel} Sep images: ${msize}`);
      if (!msize || msize === 0) {
        return {status: 'C1'};
      }
      const img = ee.Image(mcol.first());
      // Convert to DU and mask invalid values
      const du = img.select(ozoneBand).divide(DU_PER_KG_M2).rename('DU');
      const valid = du.gt(0).and(du.lt(1000));
      const duValid = du.updateMask(valid);

      const countDict = await duValid.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: antGeom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).getInfo();
      const validCount = countDict ? (countDict.DU || 0) : 0;
      if (validCount === 0) {
        return {status: 'C2'};
      }

      const holeMask = duValid.lt(220).selfMask().rename('hole');
      const holeCountDict = await holeMask.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: antGeom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).getInfo();
      const holeCount = holeCountDict ? (holeCountDict.hole || 0) : 0;

      const areaDict = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(holeMask).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: antGeom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).getInfo();
      let area_m2 = areaDict ? areaDict.area : null;

      // Validation for C3 (null/NaN or implausible)
      if (area_m2 === null || area_m2 === undefined || isNaN(area_m2)) {
        return {status: 'C3'};
      }
      if (area_m2 < 0 || area_m2 > 1e14) { // >100 million km^2 implausible south of 60S
        return {status: 'C3'};
      }
      const area_Mkm2 = area_m2 / 1e12; // million km^2
      console.log(`${yearLabel} Sep valid px: ${validCount}; hole px: ${holeCount}; hole area (Mkm^2): ${area_Mkm2.toFixed(2)}`);
      return {status: 'OK', area_m2, validCount, holeCount};
    }

    // 3. Processing for both months
    const stats2002 = await monthStats(months[0].start, months[0].end, '2002');
    const stats2003 = await monthStats(months[1].start, months[1].end, '2003');

    // 4. Handle error/status cases
    if (stats2002.status !== 'OK' || stats2003.status !== 'OK') {
      // Prioritize specific codes
      const codes = [stats2002.status, stats2003.status];
      if (codes.includes('C1')) { console.log('C1'); return; }
      if (codes.includes('C2')) { console.log('C2'); return; }
      if (codes.includes('C3')) { console.log('C3'); return; }
      console.log('D'); return;
    }

    // 5. Final Comparison & Answer
    const area02 = stats2002.area_m2;
    const area03 = stats2003.area_m2;

    // Basic sanity check again
    if (area02 === null || area03 === null || isNaN(area02) || isNaN(area03)) {
      console.log('C3'); return;
    }

    const increased = area03 > area02;
    console.log(`Threshold: 220 DU south of 60°S; 2002->2003 change (Mkm^2): ${((area03 - area02)/1e12).toFixed(2)}`);
    if (increased) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error:', err.toString().slice(0, 200));
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
